description: Corrects or backfills one recorded clock-in or clock-out time on a visit (booking_id, from read a booking or time log), as an office person correcting a cleaner's clock does: type clock_in or clock_out, and at the real time (ISO 8601). It re-derives the visit's time log and dwell but does not re-fire a live clock-out (no capture, no cadence, no completion). Who made the change and why are recorded. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: correct_clock_time
title: Correct a visit's clock time
